exercises.why: **издал** — изда́ть (perfective): to publish, to print; to edit; to issue, to promulgate, to enact; to utter, to emit, to exhale. Wiktionary: из- + дать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **Избавь** — изба́вить (perfective): to rid, to save, to relieve. Wiktionary: из- + -ба́вить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **Избавьте** — изба́вить (perfective): to rid, to save, to relieve. Wiktionary: из- + -ба́вить.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread
to disorder, to disturb, to unsettle
to excuse, to pardon, to forgive
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: расходи́ться — to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread; расстро́ить — to disorder, to disturb, to unsettle; изво́лить — (dated, ironic) to desire, to wish; извини́ть — to excuse, to pardon, to forgive.
**избрали** — избра́ть (perfective): to choose, to elect. Wiktionary: из- + брать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to carry out, to fulfill, to execute
to be frightened (of), to be startled (of), to take fright (at); to shy (at)
to change, to alter, to modify, to edit
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: испо́лнить — to carry out, to fulfill, to execute; испуга́ться — to be frightened (of), to be startled (of), to take fright (at); to shy (at); измени́ть — to change, to alter, to modify, to edit; изве́стие — news, tidings.
**Изложи** — изложи́ть (perfective): to expound, to explain, to state, to set forth, to relate, to retell. Wiktionary: из- + ложи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **исходит** — исходи́ть (imperfective): (imperfective, _, only) to issue (from), to come (from), to originate (from), to emanate (from); (imperfective, _, only) to proceed (from), to base oneself (on)); to be drained of, to shed a lot of (blood, tears, etc.); (dated) to expire, to come to an end. Wiktionary: ис- + ходи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

Wiktionary: ис- + ходи́ть.
